sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(amount_cents) AS total_cents, sum(event_id % 97) AS checksum FROM input WHERE month >= 1

capture.scope: View creation (input binding) and one fully consumed SELECT over a fixed file set; app preparation (hashing, footer reads) excluded.

limitations: Loopback HTTP measurement of an explicit URL list; not S3, listing or globbing, physical disk or client-received bytes.
Response intersections do not prove decoding, use or wasted work.
A file without observed requests is not proof of no access when the trace is partial.
Server-written bytes are not bytes DuckDB confirmed or used.
Fresh worker means cold client only; OS and disk caches are uncontrolled.
A request's phase is where it started relative to wall-clock boundaries recorded around view creation and the SELECT; others are unattributed.
Query duration excludes view creation; elapsed includes worker setup and cleanup.
Relative paths and partition values are exported and may be sensitive.
Preview is runtime-only and omitted from exported artifacts.
